title: Missouri couple win appeal after HOA rejects 12-panel solar plan and seeks legal fees
summary_full: In a significant ruling, a Missouri couple clashed with their homeowners association over the installation of solar panels. The court decided that the HOA improperly sought legal fees, affirming that no property rules were breached. This case highlighted Missouri's solar energy legislation, which fortifies homeowners' rights to adopt renewable energy solutions. Ultimately, the appeals court reversed a previous ruling that had favored the homeowners association.
